response.sql: WITH scope_rates AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, COUNT(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS rate_count FROM fees AS f INNER JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault INNER JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope) SELECT scope, avg_net_fee_rate, rate_count, avg_net_fee_rate - AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_scope_mean FROM scope_rates ORDER BY scope;
